descriptionMarkdown:
A book of space platform modules of varying widths as well as specific configurations of those modules into working vessels. Includes starter, basic inner system, Aquilo-capable and Edge of Solar System-capable classes. The basic and advanced inner system platforms can be upgraded from basic fuel/oxidizer recipes to advanced recipes in-place. This blueprint book focuses primarily on normal-quality components and platform design.

A small number of modules are available in more compact versions, using quality components to reduce footprint. The Sprinter and Pegasus classes (advanced inner system and Aquilo-capable) also have optional upgraded versions using these quality-required modules to reduce overall footprint.

Platforms are tested with all sciences (including the first level of infinite sciences) researched, which is:
* Weapon shooting speed 6
* Physical projectile damage 7
* Laser shooting speed 7
* Laser weapons damage 7
* Stronger explosives 7
* Railgun shooting speed 1
* Railgun damage 1
* Asteroid productivity 1

 You may need to adjust the throttle controls of the platforms if your science level does not match.

Each of the fully integrated vessel classes has a few features:
* Throttle control to manage speed via pump duty cycle.
* Auto-feed of initial fuel and oxidizer to reduce manual intervention requirements.
* Asteroid chunk thresholds to maintain an evenly balanced sushi belt.
* Pre-flight checklist combinator to simplify schedule conditions.

Version 1.0.3 adds a Block 3 Sprinter-class configuration that uses foundries and tier 3 assemblers in the ammo section.  
Version 1.1.0 adds space science platforms, both stationary and inner-system looping designs. This version also adds a few upgrade blocks that rely on legendary items to reduce footprint.
title: Modular Space Platforms v1.1.0
